newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes slightly lower at 1,016.00.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes slightly lower at 1,016.00.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 0.8 centavos lower at 1,016.00 after a leading bank jumped into an unusually jittery interbank market to buy dollars, dealers said.
They said dollar sales by coffee exporters lent support to the peso late in the session, however, and helped lift it from an intraday low of 1,016.85.

Dealers reported 343 trades for a total of $128 million and said market players had been nervous about possible changes in foreign exchange policy that might be announced after the central bank's weekly policy meeting -- aimed at halting peso's recent rise against the dollar.

The bank's board of directors issued a statement after the meeting, which ended at about the same time the interbank market was closing, saying that it had no intention of changing the peso's daily floating rate exchange band, however.
